title: Mahaitareyopaniṣat
attributionNote: Mahaitareyopaniṣat, as Heritage IITKanpur's Scripture Server catalogues it (MAU), on its own shelf.
description: The summary above is the one Heritage IITKanpur's Scripture Server publishes for the text; an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Heritage Scripture Server corpus, which continues the Gita Supersite built at IIT Kanpur: the text, its classical commentaries and the translations the server may serve are held together there.
availabilityNote: The outline is held: 3 chapter(s) and 27 verse address(es), read from the server's own catalogue. The verses are not stored — the licence forbids bulk harvesting and database reconstruction — and are streamed from the API one verse at a time as the work is read, with the attribution HCAL-1.1 requires and the server's own quota and licence notice.

editions.title: Mahaitareyopaniṣat (Heritage Scripture Server transcription)
editions.rightsStatus: Tier A (the moolam and its transliterations): no modern copyright, freely redistributable. Where the API serves Tier B — the Sanskrit bhāṣya and the AI-generated, community and editorially authored translations — it is displayed non-commercially with attribution and is not relicensed here. Tier C, the authoritative modern-language translations and commentaries, is not served by the API and is not imported.
editions.attributionText: Mahaitareyopaniṣat. Accessed via Heritage Scripture Server (heritage.iitk.ac.in), licence HCAL-1.1. Source: https://heritage.iitk.ac.in/MAU
editions.structureScheme: chapter and verse, as the server's own sections and verse addresses divide the text
editions.notes: The verse index was built from the server's published verse addresses. The verses themselves are fetched from the API at read time and are shown with the licence's attribution; the licence identifier and any watermark the server returns are left in place.
